name: Strap
summary: Buy 2 ATM calls and 1 ATM put at the same strike and expiry; a long straddle weighted bullish, with three contracts and no short legs.

legs.strike_rule: SAME ATM strike as the calls

when_to_use: IV rank < 25 with a catalyst you expect to resolve with a big move, probably up. The 2:1 call weighting expresses the directional lean while keeping the downside payoff. Expensive - three long premiums - so reserve it for genuinely low IV.
max_profit: UNLIMITED to the upside (2x the slope of a straddle); large but bounded to the downside
max_loss: net debit paid, at the strike. Defined.
breakevens: upside = strike + debit/200 (two calls share the move); downside = strike - debit/100

greeks.delta: positive at entry, approximately +50 per unit (2 x 0.50 - 0.50)
greeks.theta: strongly negative - three long premiums decaying

entry_rules: IV rank < 25; reject if IV rank >= 35 (you would be buying three overpriced options).
All three contracts on the identical ATM strike and expiry.
Total debit <= 1% of equity per unit.
A dated catalyst must fall inside the expiry.
Strike liquidity: OI >= 1000 at the ATM strike, per-leg spread <= max($0.05, 8% of mid).
Single 3-contract multi-leg order at mid, pay up to mid + $0.03.
management_rules: Close at 50% gain on the debit, or on the session after the catalyst resolves, whichever comes first.
Time stop: close if 40% of the calendar time to expiry has elapsed with no move exceeding 0.75 x the implied expected move.
Hard stop at 50% loss of the debit.
Consider closing the put leg alone if the underlying gaps up more than 1.5 expected moves, converting the remainder into a pure long call position.
exit_rules: No short legs, so there is no assignment risk to the account.

Still close all legs by 15:00 ET on expiration day - long ITM options are auto-exercised by the OCC at $0.01 ITM, which would deliver SHARES into the account. Never allow a long option to be auto-exercised; close it for value.
Close any long leg trading below $0.05 rather than riding it to zero, to avoid auto-exercise surprises on the other side.
assignment_risk: None from short legs. The real operational risk is the opposite: OCC exercise-by-exception will automatically exercise any long option that finishes $0.01 or more ITM, delivering 100 or 200 shares into the account. The system must close every long leg before expiry for exactly this reason.
liquidity_needs: Moderate; needs a tight ATM chain because the position pays three spreads on entry and three on exit.
common_mistakes: Buying it in high IV before earnings and losing to the vol crush even when the direction is right; holding through the time decay of three long premiums; forgetting auto-exercise on the winning leg.
zero_dte_notes: Usable as a 0DTE event structure around 08:30 or 10:00 ET data prints, but theta at 0DTE is brutal on three long premiums - hold minutes, not hours, and use a hard time stop (close by 30 minutes after the print regardless). Alpaca gives no 0DTE greeks; solve IV from the mid and compute locally.
family: three-leg-structures (butterflies, broken-wing butterflies, lizards, three-strike ratio spreads, ladders/tree spreads, christmas trees, and three-leg stock+option hybrids)
